scenarios.name: Fresh Start (Wave 1)
scenarios.description: Wave 1, no upgrades, score 0. Absolute baseline — test core driving feel, trail formation, and first encirclement before any upgrades alter the game.
scenarios.goal: Drive, form a trail loop, encircle an enemy

scenarios.name: Trail: Loop Practice (Wave 2)
scenarios.description: Wave 2 with wider_trail + trail_echo. closeDist=60 and maxPoints=600 make loops easier to form. Practice encirclement fundamentals at low pressure.
scenarios.goal: Enclose enemies — wider trail makes loops easier

scenarios.name: Combo: Master Decay Test (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Combo pre-set to 12, combo_master active. Stop drifting and watch: normal decay is 2.0/sec, combo_master slows it to 1.0/sec — combo should take ~12s to drain instead of ~6s.
scenarios.goal: Stop drifting at 12×; count ~12 s for full decay

scenarios.name: Combo: Heal at Milestones (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: combo_heal upgrade active, hp=60 (below full). Drift to combo 3 → watch HP tick. Continue to 5, then 8. Each milestone triggers a heal event. combo_master slows decay so milestones are easier to hold.
scenarios.goal: Drift to 3, 5, 8 combo — watch HP tick each time

scenarios.name: Scoring: Full Multiplier Stack (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: score_freak (×1.5) + encircle_bonus (+50% encirclement score) + combo_master + combo=6. Encircle enemies and watch the score pop. Verify all three multipliers stack correctly.
scenarios.goal: Encircle enemies — score pop should be very large

scenarios.name: Wallride: Boundary Speed Boost (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: drift_king + nitro_drift + turbo. Drive near the arena boundary while drifting to trigger wallride: sparks appear along the nearest wall and player gets +10% speed. Test all 4 edges.
scenarios.goal: Drift near each wall edge — sparks + speed boost active

scenarios.name: Enemy: Interceptor Lead-Targeting (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Pure interceptor wave. Interceptors use 0.5s lookahead — they aim where you're going, not where you are. Change direction suddenly; they should miss slightly then correct.
scenarios.goal: Change direction sharply — interceptors should overshoot

scenarios.name: Enemy: Drifter Toggle Cycle (Wave 4)
scenarios.description: Pure drifter wave. Drifters toggle drift every 2–3.5s — their hitbox shifts and they briefly arc. Encircling during a drift window is harder; wait for the straight phase.
scenarios.goal: Encircle during drift arc (hard) vs straight phase (easy)

scenarios.name: Enemy: Blocker Trail Parking (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: Pure blocker wave with wider_trail. Blockers target the centroid of your trail and park there to obstruct loops. They actively reposition as the trail moves — displace them by building a new trail section.
scenarios.goal: Build trail; blockers park in it — displace then loop

scenarios.name: Enemy: Flanker Perpendicular Strike (Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Pure flanker wave. Flankers approach perpendicular to your velocity then charge when <120px. The strike direction changes as you change direction — vary speed to bait early charges.
scenarios.goal: Change direction to bait the flank angle, then loop

scenarios.name: Enemy: Bomber Hazard Zone Drop (Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Pure bomber wave. Bombers orbit ~300px ahead and drop hazard zones every 4s. Verify: red hazard circles spawn and linger (CFG.BOMB_ZONE_DURATION). Near-missing a zone scores 15pts.
scenarios.goal: Near-miss a hazard zone edge for +15 pts

scenarios.name: Enemy: Elite 2-Hit Armor (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: Wave 5, score=2500. Elites cannot be biased — they appear as a 12% post-pick override from wave 4+. Play normally; ~1 in 8 enemies will be an elite (larger radius, takes 2 encirclement hits to kill). Verify the HP=2 visual distinction.
scenarios.goal: Encircle an elite twice — 2nd hit kills it

scenarios.name: Defense: Near-Miss Streak ×3 (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: ghost_frame upgrade, interceptor pressure. Graze 3 enemies consecutively within the 2s streak window to trigger invulnerability. 3rd near-miss grants 0.3s ghost frame — you can pass through enemies briefly.
scenarios.goal: Graze 3 enemies in 2 s for ghost-frame invuln

scenarios.name: Defense: Full Tank Build (Wave 8)
scenarios.description: Shield + ghost_frame + thick_plating + drift_shield + damage_resist stacked, hp=30. Take deliberate hits: shield absorbs first collision, damage_resist reduces all subsequent, drift_shield cuts damage further while drifting.
scenarios.goal: Take hits deliberately — verify shield → resist chain

scenarios.name: Defense: Dash Burst Invuln (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: dash_burst + turbo, interceptor pressure. Tap brake at high speed to trigger the invuln dash. Verify: brief invuln window activates (can tank a hit), 3s cooldown before next use.
scenarios.goal: Build up speed, then tap BRAKE — invuln dash triggers

scenarios.name: Trail Burn: Damage on Contact (Wave 4)
scenarios.description: trail_burn + wider_trail + trail_echo, chaser bias. Enemies touching the trail take 1 damage/sec. Verify: chasers parked on the trail slowly die without encirclement. Chain kills count toward combo.
scenarios.goal: Park enemies on trail — they die over time

scenarios.name: Chain Lightning: Kill Chain (Wave 4)
scenarios.description: chain_lightning + wider_trail, chaser/interceptor mix. Encircle a packed group — kill chains 1 damage to the nearest enemy within 200px. Pack enemies tight to see multi-kill chains. Verify chain FX and combo.
scenarios.goal: Encircle 2+ packed enemies — chain kills nearest second

scenarios.name: Horde: Incoming Event (Wave 4)
scenarios.description: Wave 4, score=600 (cadence mult 0.9× active). Loads at 62% wave progress — horde fires within a few seconds at the 60–85% threshold. Watch for HORDE INCOMING! banner + screen shake + mass-spawn.
scenarios.goal: Wait a few seconds — HORDE fires at 60–85 % wave

scenarios.name: Speed Demon: Player vs Enemy Speed (Wave 6)
scenarios.description: speed_demon + drift_king. Player gets +20% max speed but enemies get +10% speed (speedBonus +40). The game feels faster overall — verify enemies are noticeably harder to outrun than at wave 6 without this upgrade.
scenarios.goal: Play the wave — feel the player vs enemy speed tradeoff

scenarios.name: Scrap: Magnet + Trail Magnet (Wave 4)
scenarios.description: magnet (150px auto-collect) + trail_magnet (trail pulls scraps at 80px). 25 scrap tokens scattered around player at load; no enemies. Drive past tokens without touching them — verify auto-pull at range.
scenarios.goal: Drive past scraps — auto-pull at 150 px / 80 px trail

scenarios.name: Endgame: Max Speed Bonus (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15, score=7000 (max speed bonus 120 active), combo=8, jungle biome. Full enemy variety, heavy fog, peak spawn cadence. Tests all systems firing simultaneously at maximum difficulty.
scenarios.goal: Survive — verify FPS holds at max enemy variety + fog

scenarios.name: Boss: Pursuer (Wave 5)
scenarios.description: Wave 5 boss fight, no upgrades, wasteland biome. Telegraph → orbit at r≈200 → charge at 700 speed. Takes 8 encirclement chip hits to kill. hp=999 so the full fight can be observed.
scenarios.goal: Chip boss 8× with trail loops — avoid orbit-charge

scenarios.name: Boss: Core (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Wave 10 boss fight, no upgrades, rupture biome. Cycles: armored 5s (trail damage blocked) → vulnerable 3s (gold tint — encircle now). Minion ring spawns during armored phase (cap 12). hp=999 for full observation.
scenarios.goal: Wait for gold tint (vulnerable window) — only then encircle

scenarios.name: Boss: Reflector (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15 boss fight, no upgrades, jungle biome. Permanently armored — trail encirclement NEVER damages it. Figure-eight movement. Wave ends via timer, not kill. hp=999 to survive the full wave.
scenarios.goal: Survive the timer — this boss cannot be killed

scenarios.name: Boss: Core (Wave 10) — Loaded
scenarios.description: Wave 10 core boss, rupture biome, 4 offensive/defensive upgrades. hp=999 for full observation.
scenarios.goal: Test DPS feel with turbo + combo_master vs Core

scenarios.name: Boss: Pursuer (Wave 5) — Fragile
scenarios.description: Wave 5 boss, 1 HP. For learning the pursuer charge pattern under pressure.
scenarios.goal: Learn the charge pattern — die quickly to see it

scenarios.name: Biome: Neon Wasteland (Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Wave 3, wasteland biome. Verify: white tint, orange fog (density 0.04), no enemy bias, wasteland music pack.
scenarios.goal: Verify: white tint, orange fog (0.04), wasteland music

scenarios.name: Biome: Frozen Rupture (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Wave 10, rupture biome. Verify: ice-blue tint 0xCCEEFF, blue fog (density 0.06), flanker bias ×1.8, rupture music pack.
scenarios.goal: Verify: ice-blue tint, blue fog (0.06), rupture music

scenarios.name: Biome: Corruption Jungle (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Wave 15 jungle biome. Verify: green tint 0x88FF88, heavy green fog (density 0.12), jungle music pack.
scenarios.goal: Verify: green tint, heavy fog (0.12), jungle music

scenarios.name: Pickup: Time Slow
scenarios.description: Wave 3, no enemies. Blue clock pickup spawned directly next to player on load. Verify: icon renders, collecting triggers 3s slow-mo, time returns to normal.
scenarios.goal: Collect the blue clock — time slows for 3 s

scenarios.name: Pickup: Trail Token
scenarios.description: Wave 3, no enemies. Magenta diamond pickup spawned directly next to player on load. Verify: icon renders, collecting adds +200 max trail points.
scenarios.goal: Collect the magenta diamond — trail cap increases

scenarios.name: Pickup: Shield Pickup
scenarios.description: Wave 4, hp=1, no enemies. Green pentagon pickup spawned directly next to player on load. With 1 HP, collecting the shield and then surviving a hit is immediately obvious as life-or-death feedback.
scenarios.goal: Collect shield (hp=1), then survive one hit

scenarios.name: Shop: Flush (300 Scrap, Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Opens directly at the upgrade break with 300 scrap. All shop items purchasable: Field Repair (8), Brief Invincibility (5), Score Surge (12). Verify affordability highlight and scrap deduction.
scenarios.goal: Buy items — verify affordability highlight + deduction

scenarios.name: Shop: Broke (0 Scrap, Wave 3)
scenarios.description: Opens directly at the upgrade break with 0 scrap. All shop buttons should appear disabled. Verify no purchase is possible.
scenarios.goal: Verify all shop buttons disabled at 0 scrap

scenarios.name: Splitter Unlock (Score 3500, Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Wave 6 with score pre-set to 3500 — the threshold where splitters enter the enemy pool. Verify: splitters appear, split into 2 chasers on trail-encirclement kill. NOTE: bomb kill does NOT trigger split.
scenarios.goal: Encircle a splitter — 2 chasers spawn; bomb kill = no split

scenarios.name: Splitter Stress (Wave 8)
scenarios.description: Wave 8 rupture biome with offensive upgrades. Tests splitter + chaser spawns under combat load.
scenarios.goal: Large encirclements — verify no orphaned chaser states

scenarios.name: Upgrade Bias: Rupture (Wave 10)
scenarios.description: Opens directly at the upgrade break with 300 scrap and 99 free rerolls. At wave 10 rupture biome, tight_turns and drift_king should appear more often (×2 bias), drift_shield at ×1.5. Reroll to confirm bias holds.
scenarios.goal: Reroll repeatedly — tight_turns/drift_king should dominate

scenarios.name: Upgrade Bias: Jungle (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Opens directly at the upgrade break with 300 scrap and 99 free rerolls. At wave 15 jungle biome, max_hp and hp_regen should appear more often (×2 bias), damage_resist at ×1.5. Reroll to confirm bias holds.
scenarios.goal: Reroll repeatedly — max_hp/hp_regen should dominate

scenarios.name: Boss Reward: Simulated Kill (Wave 6)
scenarios.description: Opens directly at the upgrade break with bossDefeated=true. Gold flash + shake + BOSS DEFEATED! banner fires at load. Upgrade break should show +1 reroll on top of the base count.
scenarios.goal: Watch BOSS DEFEATED flow — upgrade break has +1 reroll

scenarios.name: Combo: Cyan Ring (Combo 4)
scenarios.description: Wave 5, combo=4, combo_master active (slows decay so the combo holds long enough to encircle). Verify: encirclement ring is cyan (4–6× range).
scenarios.goal: Encircle an enemy — ring should be cyan (combo 4–6)

scenarios.name: Combo: Magenta Ring + Shard Burst (Combo 7)
scenarios.description: Wave 8, combo=7, score=2000, combo_master active (holds combo above 7 threshold). Verify: magenta ring, shard burst on 3+ enemy encirclement (cap 30 particles). Also tests MAX_COMBO=16 range.
scenarios.goal: Encircle 3+ packed enemies — magenta ring + shard burst

scenarios.name: Biome Transition: Rupture Entry (Wave 8)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Starts at wave 8 in rupture biome. Verify: blue tint 0x99BBFF, fog 0.13, flanker-heavy spawn pool, rupture music (tron lead), crystal hazard props (collision + damage).
scenarios.goal: Verify rupture: blue tint + fog, flankers, crystal prop damage

scenarios.name: Biome Transition: Jungle Entry (Wave 15)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Starts at wave 15 in jungle biome. Verify: green tint, heavy green fog (0.20), corruption zone spawning + growth, slipstream music lead.
scenarios.goal: Verify jungle: heavy fog, corruption zones growing, slipstream music

scenarios.name: Biome Branching: Route Choice (Wave 7 break)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Opens the upgrade break at wave 7. After picking an upgrade, the biome chooser should appear: Rupture (normal) vs Jungle (+50% score). Verify chooser UI, keyboard/gamepad/touch input, and banner on confirmation.
scenarios.goal: Pick upgrade, then choose biome — verify chooser UI + score badge

scenarios.name: Hazard: Wasteland Heat Cracks (Wave 2)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Wave 2 wasteland, no enemies. Heat crack zones: orange telegraph outline (1.5 s), then bright eruption (1.2 s burst 12 damage if inside). Verify telegraph → erupt → expire cycle.
scenarios.goal: Watch crack zones: dim outline → bright burst → gone

scenarios.name: Hazard: Rupture Crystal Props (Wave 9)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Wave 9 rupture biome, no enemies. Drive into rock props — normal solid rocks bounce without damage; crystal (hazard) rocks bounce AND deal 8 damage respecting invuln timer.
scenarios.goal: Hit solid rock (bounce only) then crystal rock (bounce + damage)

scenarios.name: Hazard: Jungle Corruption Zones (Wave 16)
scenarios.description: Phase 4.5. Wave 16 jungle biome, no enemies. Corruption zones: spawn small (r=50), grow to r=140 over time, multiply up to cap 6. DPS + slow while inside. Verify visual: pulsing green/purple.
scenarios.goal: Watch zones grow and multiply; verify DPS + slow inside
